title.en: The Product and DPP module of an EU regulatory compliant Digital Product Passport Core Ontology (EU DPP CO) proposed by the CIRPASS-2 European project.

author: Hele-Mai Haav (up until version 1.7.1 incl.), further maintained by contributors.

description.en:
The EU DPP core ontology proposed in CIRPASS-2 European project  is a shared formal specification of basic concepts and properties/relationships in the cross-sectorial DPP domain to facilitate knowledge sharing across sector-specific DPPs.

The proposed  EU DPP core ontology captures several modules from which the Product and DPP module plays a central role.

DEPENDENCIES:  This module has dependencies to the following EU DPP Core Ontology (CO) modules: CON, ACTOR, SOC.  

For more information, see 
Maigre, R., Haav, H.-M., Robal, T., Wolf, M.-A., & Danash, F. (2025). Ontology Requirements Specification for an EU DPP Core Ontology Proposal (1.1). CIRPASS-2 Consortium. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15270342

Reliability
means the probability that a product functions as required under given conditions for a given
duration without an occurrence which results in a primary or secondary function of the product no
longer being performed. (ESPR Art 2 (16))

Reliability is usually expressed in terms of mean time between failures (MTBF), which is the average length of time that a device will operate without failure.

Product group
means a set of products that serve similar purposes and are similar in terms of use, or have similar
